answer: Stop sybils with a violet beacon check: an agent stakes a bond for one beacon. It flashes violet at a random time, and the agent must answer by whisper with work proof. Verifiers void a whisper copied, late, or answering twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bonds and whispers at 17x cost each: each whisper fits one beacon and one flash, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents stake once and keep rights.
